prompt: Give me the most searched topics on the internet
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] directly answers with broadly plausible, high-level categories of what people search for and avoids questionable quantitative or highly specific factual claims. Candidates [2] and [4] add concrete statistics/time spans and specific “top” assertions that are not supported and are likely fabricated or at least unverifiable from the prompt. Candidate [3] goes further into clearly implausible hallucinations (e.g., “Leonardo DiCaprio having a pet rhinoceros,” “Summer Penguin Olympics,” “Atlantis”), making it the least reliable response.
